_derivation.geometry: Window 320x240. Root is a column, padding 10, gap 8, alignItems flex-start, so children start at x=10 and stack downward. chip is size [120,32] -> 10,10,120,32. btn is size [120,32] after chip + gap 8 -> 10,50,120,32. sw (toggle) is size [80,32] after btn + gap 8 -> 10,90,80,32. scroll is size [200,60] after sw + gap 8 -> 10,130,200,60. row is size [200,120] and is the scroll content, so it keeps its full height and is clipped by the viewport -> 10,130,200,120.
points: (13,150) is inside the scroll viewport, and the row button fills it: #cccccc.
